about: Golden vectors for mw-signin-v1 (docs/specs/mw-signin-v1.md): every positive and negative case of R 2.3.2. APPEND ONLY: never edit or remove a vector; add new ones with new ids and append their hashes to LOCK.json. proof is the request body text; verifier holds createVerifier options plus the verifier clock `now`; nonce is the state of proof.c.nonce in the store before verify (issued, used, unknown); issued is the statement and resources stored with the issued nonce.
